player.description: Who is resuming; must equal the envelope from.

logHash.description: Hash of the last log entry this participant holds; 64 zeros when it holds none.

signature.description: The participant's signature over canonicalJson({matchId, player, logHash, logLength}) with its roster key. In a lobby (A17; `match` is present) it is over canonicalJson({lobby, player, match, logHash, logLength, seq}): the lobby's code, the same `match` as below, and the envelope's own `seq`, so that a captured RECONNECT cannot be sent again in a new envelope.

resends.description: A18: true when the sender sends again, right after an accepted RECONNECT, its own BALL_END, GAME_OVER, FORFEIT and LOG_SIGN that the host never answered. Absent or false: it does not, and a ball end it reported into the dropped link comes back only for a grant the host issues again (after a PAUSE and its RESUME).

match.description: A17: the match the sender holds a log of; null: none. Absent: a RECONNECT from before the lobby, whose envelope names the match.

anyOf.description: The Throwdown code from ArcAid, or any unique string in a local/fake match.

description: client -> host. First frame on a new socket to the current host, after a drop or a host transfer; never a fresh HELLO.
